blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__campaign_flow_metrics
      description: Campaign/flow-level metrics aggregated from events with touch resolution via direct IDs or attributed parent events
      grain: One row per (source_relation, variation_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      business_logic: '- From staging.stg_klaviyo__event, derive per event a touch_id and touch_type: use campaign_id and ''campaign'' when campaign_id is present; otherwise use flow_id and ''flow'' when flow_id is present. - For events without a direct touch_id but with event_attribution: - Remove all "$" characters from the event_attribution payload. - Extract the attributed parent event_id from relationships.attributed-event.data.id; if not found, use attributed_event_id; remove any surrounding double quotes and treat an empty string as NULL. - In the same source_relation, find that parent event_id among all events to obtain its touch_id and touch_type. - Resolve the last-touch per event: - Use the parent event’s touch_id and touch_type when an attributed parent is found; otherwise use the event’s own. - Populate last_touch_campaign_id when the resolved touch_type is campaign, and last_touch_flow_id when it is flow; only one is set when resolved, and both may be NULL if unresolved. - Aggregate by (source_relation, variation_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id): - total_count_unique_people is the distinct count of person_id across all events; NULL person_id is excluded. - first_event_at and last_event_at are the minimum and maximum occurred_at; NULL timestamps are ignored. - Revenue sums are computed per event type, matching the exact type names case-insensitively; NULL numeric_value is treated as 0 and negative values are kept. - Event counts tally the number of events for each type; duplicates are counted and person_id is not considered. - Unique counts tally distinct person_id per event type within the group; NULL person_id is excluded. - Conversion rates use event counts (not unique counts); if the denominator is zero the rate is NULL; otherwise use floating-point division with no rounding. - GMV gross is the sum of numeric_value for ''placed order'' and ''ordered product''; GMV net is gross minus the sums for ''refunded order'' and ''cancelled order''; NULL numeric_value is treated as 0 and negatives are kept.'
      columns:
      - name: last_touch_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved campaign identifier when the final touch is a campaign; derived from the event or its attributed parent; NULL otherwise
      - name: last_touch_flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved flow identifier when the final touch is a flow; derived from the event or its attributed parent; NULL otherwise
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event variation identifier used in grouping; NULL values form their own group
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier; joins and grouping are scoped within each source_relation
      - name: total_count_unique_people
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of person_id within the group across all event types; NULL person_id excluded
      - name: first_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest occurred_at within the group; NULL occurred_at ignored; NULL only if all are NULL
      - name: last_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest occurred_at within the group; NULL occurred_at ignored; NULL only if all are NULL
      - name: sum_revenue_refunded_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for 'refunded order' events; NULL numeric_value treated as 0; negatives preserved
      - name: sum_revenue_placed_order
        data_type: DOUBLE

references.line_text: business_logic: '- From staging.stg_klaviyo__event, derive per event a touch_id and touch_type: use campaign_id and ''campaign'' when campaign_id is present; otherwise use flow_id and ''flow'' when flow_id is present. - For events without a direct touch_id but with event_attribution: - Remove all "$" characters from the event_attribution payload. - Extract the attributed parent event_id from relationships.attributed-event.data.id; if not found, use attributed_event_id; remove any surrounding double quotes and treat an empty string as NULL. - In the same source_relation, find that parent event_id among all events to obtain its touch_id and touch_type. - Resolve the last-touch per event: - Use the parent event’s touch_id and touch_type when an attributed parent is found; otherwise use the event’s own. - Populate last_touch_campaign_id when the resolved touch_type is campaign, and last_touch_flow_id when it is flow; only one is set when resolved, and both may be NULL if unresolved. - Aggregate by (source_relation, variation_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id): - total_count_unique_people is the distinct count of person_id across all events; NULL person_id is excluded. - first_event_at and last_event_at are the minimum and maximum occurred_at; NULL timestamps are ignored. - Revenue sums are computed per event type, matching the exact type names case-insensitively; NULL numeric_value is treated as 0 and negative values are kept. - Event counts tally the number of events for each type; duplicates are counted and person_id is not considered. - Unique counts tally distinct person_id per event type within the group; NULL person_id is excluded. - Conversion rates use event counts (not unique counts); if the denominator is zero the rate is NULL; otherwise use floating-point division with no rounding. - GMV gross is the sum of numeric_value for ''placed order'' and ''ordered product''; GMV net is gross minus the sums for ''refunded order'' and ''cancelled order''; NULL numeric_value is treated as 0 and negatives are kept.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__campaigns_enriched
      description: Campaigns with campaign-attributed engagement and GMV metrics aggregated per variation and left-joined to campaign records.
      grain: One row per (campaign_id, variation_id, source_relation); campaigns without attributed events produce one row with variation_id and all metrics NULL.
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__campaign
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      business_logic: '- Load all campaigns from staging.stg_klaviyo__campaign. - Build events from staging.stg_klaviyo__event and derive: - touch_id: campaign_id if present, otherwise flow_id. - touch_type: "campaign" when campaign_id is present, "flow" when flow_id is present. - For events with event_attribution present and no touch_id: - Remove all "$" characters from event_attribution. - Extract the attributed event id from either relationships.attributed-event.data.id or attributed_event_id. - Remove surrounding quotes and treat empty as NULL. - Resolve inherited attribution by linking the extracted attributed event id back to the referenced event to obtain its touch_id and touch_type (matching within the same source_relation). - For each event, set last_touch_campaign_id to the inherited touch_id if available, otherwise its own touch_id, but only when the resolved touch_type is "campaign"; otherwise leave it null (flows are excluded). - Build metrics using only events where last_touch_campaign_id is present; group by: - campaign_id = last_touch_campaign_id - variation_id = the event’s variation_id - source_relation Metrics per group: - total_count_unique_people: distinct people across all attributed events (records without person_id are not counted). - count_received_email, count_opened_email, count_clicked_email, count_placed_order, count_ordered_product, count_refunded_order: number of events matching each exact phrase; comparisons are case-insensitive. - gmv_gross: sum of numeric_value for "placed order" and "ordered product" events, treating missing numeric_value as 0. - gmv_net: gmv_gross minus the sum of numeric_value for "refunded order" and "cancelled order" events, treating missing numeric_value as 0. - email_open_rate: opened / received; null when received is 0. - email_click_to_open_rate: clicked / opened; null when opened is 0. Determinism and null handling: - Event type matching is case-insensitive, requires exact phrase matches, and all events are included as-is. - Within an existing metrics group, counts/sums return 0 when no matching events occur; numeric_value nulls contribute 0. - Campaigns with no attributed events produce no metrics group; after the left join all metric fields (including variation_id) are NULL. - Left join metrics to campaigns on (campaign_id, source_relation). - Compute campaign_variation_key as an MD5 hash of campaign_id + "|" + variation_id, using an empty string when variation_id is null; original casing and spacing are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier from the source campaign record; join key to metrics.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: CAMPAIGN_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign type label from the source campaign record.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign creation timestamp as a string from the source campaign record.
      - name: EMAIL_TEMPLATE_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email template identifier from the source campaign record.
      - name: from_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sender email address from the source campaign record.
      - name: FROM_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sender display name from the source campaign record.
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name or title from the source campaign record.
      - name: scheduled_to_send_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Scheduled send timestamp from the source campaign record.
      - name: SENT_AT
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Actual send timestamp from the source campaign record.
      - name: STATUS
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign status string from the source campaign record.
      - name: STATUS_ID
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Numeric status identifier from the source campaign record.
      - name: SUBJECT
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email subject line from the source campaign record.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp from the source campaign record.
      - name: is_archived
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Archive flag from the source campaign record.
      - name: scheduled_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Scheduling timestamp as a string from the source campaign record.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream source identifier from campaigns used to partition joins to events.
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Variation identifier from events used for grouping; null if no metrics exist or the group’s variation is null.
      - name: total_count_unique_people
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct people with any attributed event for this campaign and variation; records without person_id are ignored.
      - name: count_received_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of attributed 'received email' events for this campaign and variation (case-insensitive match).
      - name: count_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of attributed 'opened email' events for this campaign and variation (case-insensitive match).
      - name: count_clicked_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of attributed 'clicked email' events for this campaign and variation (case-insensitive match).
      - name: count_placed_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of attributed 'placed order' events for this campaign and variation (case-insensitive match).
      - name: count_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of attributed 'ordered product' events for this campaign and variation (case-insensitive match).
      - name: count_refunded_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of attributed 'refunded order' events for this campaign and variation (case-insensitive match).
      - name: gmv_gross
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross merchandise value from 'placed order' and 'ordered product' events, summing numeric_value with null treated as 0.
      - name: gmv_net
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Net merchandise value: gmv_gross minus value from ''refunded order'' and ''cancelled order'' events, treating null numeric_value as 0.'
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Open rate computed as opened divided by received; null when received is 0; no rounding.
      - name: email_click_to_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Click-to-open rate computed as clicked divided by opened; null when opened is 0; no rounding.
      - name: campaign_variation_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stable MD5 hash of campaign_id, a pipe (|), and variation_id with null variation treated as empty.

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Load all campaigns from staging.stg_klaviyo__campaign. - Build events from staging.stg_klaviyo__event and derive: - touch_id: campaign_id if present, otherwise flow_id. - touch_type: "campaign" when campaign_id is present, "flow" when flow_id is present. - For events with event_attribution present and no touch_id: - Remove all "$" characters from event_attribution. - Extract the attributed event id from either relationships.attributed-event.data.id or attributed_event_id. - Remove surrounding quotes and treat empty as NULL. - Resolve inherited attribution by linking the extracted attributed event id back to the referenced event to obtain its touch_id and touch_type (matching within the same source_relation). - For each event, set last_touch_campaign_id to the inherited touch_id if available, otherwise its own touch_id, but only when the resolved touch_type is "campaign"; otherwise leave it null (flows are excluded). - Build metrics using only events where last_touch_campaign_id is present; group by: - campaign_id = last_touch_campaign_id - variation_id = the event’s variation_id - source_relation Metrics per group: - total_count_unique_people: distinct people across all attributed events (records without person_id are not counted). - count_received_email, count_opened_email, count_clicked_email, count_placed_order, count_ordered_product, count_refunded_order: number of events matching each exact phrase; comparisons are case-insensitive. - gmv_gross: sum of numeric_value for "placed order" and "ordered product" events, treating missing numeric_value as 0. - gmv_net: gmv_gross minus the sum of numeric_value for "refunded order" and "cancelled order" events, treating missing numeric_value as 0. - email_open_rate: opened / received; null when received is 0. - email_click_to_open_rate: clicked / opened; null when opened is 0. Determinism and null handling: - Event type matching is case-insensitive, requires exact phrase matches, and all events are included as-is. - Within an existing metrics group, counts/sums return 0 when no matching events occur; numeric_value nulls contribute 0. - Campaigns with no attributed events produce no metrics group; after the left join all metric fields (including variation_id) are NULL. - Left join metrics to campaigns on (campaign_id, source_relation). - Compute campaign_variation_key as an MD5 hash of campaign_id + "|" + variation_id, using an empty string when variation_id is null; original casing and spacing are preserved.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__events
      description: Events enriched with inherited touch attribution, joined dimensions, session features, and non-negative revenue fields
      grain: One row per (source_relation, event_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__campaign
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__flow
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__person
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__metric
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_klaviyo__event and derive direct touch fields: touch_id is campaign_id when present, otherwise flow_id; touch_type is ''campaign'' or ''flow'' accordingly. - For events with event_attribution and no direct touch_id, inherit touch from the attributed child: - Remove "$" characters from event_attribution. - Extract the child event id by first looking for relationships.attributed-event.data.id, else attributed_event_id. - Remove surrounding quotes and treat empty values as NULL. - Join back to the events set on source_relation and the extracted child event_id to obtain the child''s touch_id and touch_type. - Set last_touch_id and session_touch_type to the child''s values when found; otherwise use the event’s direct touch_id and touch_type. - Derive occurred_on by truncating occurred_at to the calendar day (date type). - For each person, prev_event_at is the timestamp of the immediately prior event ordered by occurred_at; when none exists it is NULL; ties on identical timestamps follow engine-defined order. - Session features: - inter_event_minutes is the rounded difference in minutes between prev_event_at and occurred_at; NULL when prev_event_at is NULL. - session_seq is a running count per person that starts at 1 and increases by 1 when prev_event_at is NULL or the gap between events exceeds 30 minutes. - Join dimensions with LEFT JOINs scoped by source_relation: - Campaign: only when the effective touch type (session_touch_type if present else touch_type) is ''campaign''; match on the resolved touch id (last_touch_id if present else touch_id). - Flow: only when the effective touch type is ''flow''; match on the resolved touch id (last_touch_id if present else touch_id). - Person: join on person_id. - Metric: join on metric_id. - If a key is not applicable or no match is found, the related dimension fields are NULL. - Derived flags and normalized revenue: - is_engagement_event = 1 when type is one of {''active on site'',''viewed product'',''opened email'',''clicked email'',''received email''} ignoring case; else 0. - amount_positive = numeric_value when type is ''placed order'' or ''ordered product'' (case-insensitive) and numeric_value is non-negative; otherwise 0. - amount_negative = numeric_value when type is ''refunded order'' or ''cancelled order'' (case-insensitive) and numeric_value is non-negative; otherwise 0.'

      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier used to scope joins and grain
      - name: event_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event identifier unique within source_relation; one output row per (source_relation, event_id)

      - name: event_attribution

        description: Raw JSON attribution string used to inherit touch from an attributed child; may be NULL
      - name: occurred_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Event timestamp; used for date derivation, window lag, and session segmentation
      - name: occurred_on

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_klaviyo__event and derive direct touch fields: touch_id is campaign_id when present, otherwise flow_id; touch_type is ''campaign'' or ''flow'' accordingly. - For events with event_attribution and no direct touch_id, inherit touch from the attributed child: - Remove "$" characters from event_attribution. - Extract the child event id by first looking for relationships.attributed-event.data.id, else attributed_event_id. - Remove surrounding quotes and treat empty values as NULL. - Join back to the events set on source_relation and the extracted child event_id to obtain the child''s touch_id and touch_type. - Set last_touch_id and session_touch_type to the child''s values when found; otherwise use the event’s direct touch_id and touch_type. - Derive occurred_on by truncating occurred_at to the calendar day (date type). - For each person, prev_event_at is the timestamp of the immediately prior event ordered by occurred_at; when none exists it is NULL; ties on identical timestamps follow engine-defined order. - Session features: - inter_event_minutes is the rounded difference in minutes between prev_event_at and occurred_at; NULL when prev_event_at is NULL. - session_seq is a running count per person that starts at 1 and increases by 1 when prev_event_at is NULL or the gap between events exceeds 30 minutes. - Join dimensions with LEFT JOINs scoped by source_relation: - Campaign: only when the effective touch type (session_touch_type if present else touch_type) is ''campaign''; match on the resolved touch id (last_touch_id if present else touch_id). - Flow: only when the effective touch type is ''flow''; match on the resolved touch id (last_touch_id if present else touch_id). - Person: join on person_id. - Metric: join on metric_id. - If a key is not applicable or no match is found, the related dimension fields are NULL. - Derived flags and normalized revenue: - is_engagement_event = 1 when type is one of {''active on site'',''viewed product'',''opened email'',''clicked email'',''received email''} ignoring case; else 0. - amount_positive = numeric_value when type is ''placed order'' or ''ordered product'' (case-insensitive) and numeric_value is non-negative; otherwise 0. - amount_negative = numeric_value when type is ''refunded order'' or ''cancelled order'' (case-insensitive) and numeric_value is non-negative; otherwise 0.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__flows_enriched
      description: Flow dimension enriched with flow-attributed engagement counts, GMV, and rates derived from events.
      grain: One row per flow_id per source_relation per variation_id (variation_id is NULL when no metrics).
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__flow
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      business_logic: '- Load all flows from staging.stg_klaviyo__flow. - From staging.stg_klaviyo__event, assign a touch_id using campaign_id if present, otherwise flow_id; touch_type is ''campaign'' when campaign_id exists, otherwise ''flow'' when flow_id exists. - Identify child events lacking a touch_id but having event_attribution; remove dollar signs from event_attribution; parse the JSON to extract the attributed event id from either relationships.attributed-event.data.id or attributed_event_id; strip quotes and treat empty strings as NULL. - Build a lookup from event_id to (touch_id, touch_type, source_relation) using all events. - For each event, resolve the flow attribution: - If an attributed parent event is found, inherit its touch_id and touch_type; otherwise use the event’s own touch_id and touch_type. - Keep last_touch_flow_id only when the resulting touch_type is ''flow''; otherwise there is no flow attribution. - Retain person_id, variation_id, source_relation, event type, and numeric_value. - Keep only events with a non-null last_touch_flow_id and group by (last_touch_flow_id as flow_id), variation_id, and source_relation. - For each group: - total_count_unique_people: distinct count of person_id (NULL values are ignored). - count_* metrics: number of events where the lowercase event type exactly matches the phrase (''received email'', ''opened email'', ''clicked email'', ''placed order'', ''ordered product'', ''refunded order''); NULL types do not match. - gmv_gross: sum of numeric_value for ''placed order'' and ''ordered product''; missing amounts are treated as 0. - gmv_net: gmv_gross minus the sum of numeric_value for ''refunded order'' and ''cancelled order''; missing amounts are treated as 0. - email_open_rate: opened divided by received as a floating-point ratio; NULL when received equals 0. - email_click_to_open_rate: clicked divided by opened as a floating-point ratio; NULL when opened equals 0. - Left join these metrics to flows on flow_id and source_relation so all flows are retained; when a flow has no attributed events, all metrics (including variation_id) are NULL. - Compute flow_variation_key as the MD5 hash of flow_id, a pipe character "|", and variation_id (use an empty string when variation_id is NULL). All steps are performed independently within each source_relation.'
      columns:
      - name: created_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creation timestamp from the flows source.
      - name: flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary flow identifier used to join flows to metrics.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: flow_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow name from the source.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow status from the source.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last update timestamp from the source.
      - name: is_archived
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates whether the flow is archived.
      - name: trigger_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: The flow's trigger type.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier that scopes joins and metrics.
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow variation identifier from metrics grouping; NULL when no attributed events.
      - name: total_count_unique_people
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of people with events attributed to the flow; NULL person_id values are ignored.
      - name: count_received_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'received email'; NULL types do not count.
      - name: count_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'opened email'; NULL types do not count.
      - name: count_clicked_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'clicked email'; NULL types do not count.
      - name: count_placed_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'placed order'; NULL types do not count.
      - name: count_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'ordered product'; NULL types do not count.
      - name: count_refunded_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Events whose lowercase type equals 'refunded order'; NULL types do not count.
      - name: gmv_gross
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for 'placed order' and 'ordered product' events; missing amounts are treated as 0.
      - name: gmv_net
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: GMV gross minus the sum of numeric_value for 'refunded order' and 'cancelled order'; missing amounts are treated as 0.
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opened divided by received as a floating-point ratio; NULL when received equals 0.
      - name: email_click_to_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicked divided by opened as a floating-point ratio; NULL when opened equals 0.
      - name: flow_variation_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 hash of flow_id, a pipe '|', and variation_id (empty string when NULL) for a deterministic flow+variation key.

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Load all flows from staging.stg_klaviyo__flow. - From staging.stg_klaviyo__event, assign a touch_id using campaign_id if present, otherwise flow_id; touch_type is ''campaign'' when campaign_id exists, otherwise ''flow'' when flow_id exists. - Identify child events lacking a touch_id but having event_attribution; remove dollar signs from event_attribution; parse the JSON to extract the attributed event id from either relationships.attributed-event.data.id or attributed_event_id; strip quotes and treat empty strings as NULL. - Build a lookup from event_id to (touch_id, touch_type, source_relation) using all events. - For each event, resolve the flow attribution: - If an attributed parent event is found, inherit its touch_id and touch_type; otherwise use the event’s own touch_id and touch_type. - Keep last_touch_flow_id only when the resulting touch_type is ''flow''; otherwise there is no flow attribution. - Retain person_id, variation_id, source_relation, event type, and numeric_value. - Keep only events with a non-null last_touch_flow_id and group by (last_touch_flow_id as flow_id), variation_id, and source_relation. - For each group: - total_count_unique_people: distinct count of person_id (NULL values are ignored). - count_* metrics: number of events where the lowercase event type exactly matches the phrase (''received email'', ''opened email'', ''clicked email'', ''placed order'', ''ordered product'', ''refunded order''); NULL types do not match. - gmv_gross: sum of numeric_value for ''placed order'' and ''ordered product''; missing amounts are treated as 0. - gmv_net: gmv_gross minus the sum of numeric_value for ''refunded order'' and ''cancelled order''; missing amounts are treated as 0. - email_open_rate: opened divided by received as a floating-point ratio; NULL when received equals 0. - email_click_to_open_rate: clicked divided by opened as a floating-point ratio; NULL when opened equals 0. - Left join these metrics to flows on flow_id and source_relation so all flows are retained; when a flow has no attributed events, all metrics (including variation_id) are NULL. - Compute flow_variation_key as the MD5 hash of flow_id, a pipe character "|", and variation_id (use an empty string when variation_id is NULL). All steps are performed independently within each source_relation.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__person_campaign_flow
      description: Person-level campaign/flow touch metrics resolved via event_attribution; aggregated per person/touch/variation/source_relation
      grain: One row per person_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id, variation_id, source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_klaviyo__event and process within each source_relation. - Derive each event’s direct touch: - Use campaign_id as touch_id when present; otherwise use flow_id. - touch_type is "campaign" when campaign_id is present, else "flow" when flow_id is present; if both are present, treat it as "campaign". - For events where event_attribution is present and no direct touch_id: - Remove all "$" characters from event_attribution; parse as JSON to extract the attributed event id from relationships.attributed-event.data.id, falling back to attributed_event_id. - Remove surrounding quotes; treat an empty string as null. - Within the same source_relation, find the event with that id and take its touch_id and touch_type as inherited. - Resolve per-event touch: - Use the inherited touch_id and touch_type when available; otherwise use the direct values. - last_touch_campaign_id is the resolved touch_id when the resolved touch_type is "campaign"; otherwise null. - last_touch_flow_id is the resolved touch_id when the resolved touch_type is "flow"; otherwise null. - Aggregate by person_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id, variation_id, source_relation: - first_event_at is the earliest occurred_at; last_event_at is the latest; null timestamps are ignored, and if all are null the result is null. - Revenue metrics: for each listed event type, sum numeric_value for matching events, treating missing numeric_value as 0; type matching is case-insensitive; the numeric_value sign is preserved. - Engagement metrics: for each listed event type, count matching events; type matching is case-insensitive; non-matching or null types contribute 0. - Output one row per group with resolved touch identifiers, timestamps, revenue sums, and counts.'
      columns:
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique person identifier used for grouping
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: last_touch_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved campaign touch identifier when the resolved touch type is campaign; otherwise NULL; for direct events, campaign overrides flow if both exist
      - name: last_touch_flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved flow touch identifier when the resolved touch type is flow; otherwise NULL
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event variation identifier used in grouping; may be NULL
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source dataset key that scopes attribution and grouping
      - name: first_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest occurred_at in the group; NULL if all timestamps are NULL
      - name: last_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest occurred_at in the group; NULL if all timestamps are NULL
      - name: sum_revenue_refunded_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total numeric_value for events where type equals 'refunded order' (case-insensitive); NULL values are treated as 0; value sign is preserved
      - name: sum_revenue_placed_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total numeric_value for events where type equals 'placed order' (case-insensitive); NULL values are treated as 0; value sign is preserved
      - name: sum_revenue_ordered_product
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total numeric_value for events where type equals 'ordered product' (case-insensitive); NULL values are treated as 0; value sign is preserved
      - name: sum_revenue_checkout_started
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total numeric_value for events where type equals 'checkout started' (case-insensitive); NULL values are treated as 0; value sign is preserved
      - name: sum_revenue_cancelled_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total numeric_value for events where type equals 'cancelled order' (case-insensitive); NULL values are treated as 0; value sign is preserved
      - name: count_active_on_site
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of events where type equals 'active on site' (case-insensitive) in the group

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_klaviyo__event and process within each source_relation. - Derive each event’s direct touch: - Use campaign_id as touch_id when present; otherwise use flow_id. - touch_type is "campaign" when campaign_id is present, else "flow" when flow_id is present; if both are present, treat it as "campaign". - For events where event_attribution is present and no direct touch_id: - Remove all "$" characters from event_attribution; parse as JSON to extract the attributed event id from relationships.attributed-event.data.id, falling back to attributed_event_id. - Remove surrounding quotes; treat an empty string as null. - Within the same source_relation, find the event with that id and take its touch_id and touch_type as inherited. - Resolve per-event touch: - Use the inherited touch_id and touch_type when available; otherwise use the direct values. - last_touch_campaign_id is the resolved touch_id when the resolved touch_type is "campaign"; otherwise null. - last_touch_flow_id is the resolved touch_id when the resolved touch_type is "flow"; otherwise null. - Aggregate by person_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id, variation_id, source_relation: - first_event_at is the earliest occurred_at; last_event_at is the latest; null timestamps are ignored, and if all are null the result is null. - Revenue metrics: for each listed event type, sum numeric_value for matching events, treating missing numeric_value as 0; type matching is case-insensitive; the numeric_value sign is preserved. - Engagement metrics: for each listed event type, count matching events; type matching is case-insensitive; non-matching or null types contribute 0. - Output one row per group with resolved touch identifiers, timestamps, revenue sums, and counts.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__person_metrics
      description: Per-person metrics from Klaviyo events including activity windows, continuity diagnostics, event counts, revenue sums, and conversion rates
      grain: One row per person_id per source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event
      business_logic: '- Inputs: person_id, source_relation, occurred_at (timestamp), type (event name), numeric_value. - Event normalization: - occurred_on is the calendar date of occurred_at (time removed). If occurred_at is NULL, occurred_on is NULL. - Event type matching is case-insensitive exact string comparison; spacing and punctuation are not altered. - Activity span per person_id + source_relation: - first_event_on is the earliest occurred_on date; last_event_on is the latest. Both are NULL when all occurred_on are NULL. - Date spine and continuity: - Build an inclusive list of every calendar day from first_event_on through last_event_on for each person_id + source_relation. - missing_day_count equals the number of spine days that have no events on that exact date; multiple events on a day do not change this count; set to NULL when the span is undefined. - Aggregations per person_id + source_relation: - Revenue sums: For the listed revenue types, sum numeric_value; treat NULL numeric_value as 0; retain negative values. - Event counts: Count every event whose type matches the listed name; events with NULL type do not match. - Active periods: Count distinct calendar days, distinct Monday-based calendar weeks, and distinct calendar months with at least one event; NULL dates are ignored. - Conversion rates: - Divide the specified numerator by its denominator; return NULL when the denominator is zero; computed with floating-point division and not rounded. - Output includes one row for each (person_id, source_relation) present in the events.'
      columns:
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique person identifier
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event source identifier; with person_id defines the row
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest event date for the person and source; NULL when no dated events
      - name: last_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest event date for the person and source; NULL when no dated events
      - name: sum_revenue_refunded_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total numeric_value for 'refunded order' events; NULL numeric_value counts as 0; negatives kept
      - name: sum_revenue_placed_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total numeric_value for 'placed order' events; NULL numeric_value counts as 0; negatives kept
      - name: sum_revenue_ordered_product
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total numeric_value for 'ordered product' events; NULL numeric_value counts as 0; negatives kept
      - name: sum_revenue_cancelled_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total numeric_value for 'cancelled order' events; NULL numeric_value counts as 0; negatives kept
      - name: count_active_on_site
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of 'active on site' events
      - name: count_viewed_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of 'viewed product' events
      - name: count_ordered_product

        description: Number of 'ordered product' events
      - name: count_placed_order

        description: Number of 'placed order' events
      - name: count_refunded_order

      - name: count_received_email

        description: Number of 'received email' events
      - name: count_clicked_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of 'clicked email' events
      - name: count_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of 'opened email' events
      - name: count_marked_email_as_spam
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of 'marked email as spam' events
      - name: count_unsubscribed
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of 'unsubscribed' events
      - name: count_received_sms
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of 'received sms' events
      - name: count_clicked_sms

        description: Number of 'clicked sms' events

      - name: count_unsubscribed_from_sms
        data_type: HUGEINT

      - name: active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct calendar days with at least one event
      - name: active_weeks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Monday-based calendar weeks with at least one event
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct calendar months with at least one event
      - name: missing_day_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of inclusive-span days with zero events; NULL when the span is undefined
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opens divided by received emails; NULL when denominator is 0; floating-point, not rounded

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_klaviyo__persons_enriched
      description: Persons from the person table left-joined with per-person, per-source_relation event metrics aggregated from staging events.
      grain: One row per person_id per source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__person (all columns)
      - staging.stg_klaviyo__event (person_id, source_relation, occurred_at, type, numeric_value)
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in staging.stg_klaviyo__person; this defines the output grain (one row per person_id and source_relation). - From staging.stg_klaviyo__event, project person_id, source_relation, occurred_on as the calendar date of occurred_at (day-level truncation, no timezone conversion), type, and numeric_value. - Aggregate events by (person_id, source_relation): - first_event_on = minimum occurred_on; last_event_on = maximum occurred_on. - Revenue sums: for each target type (''refunded order'', ''placed order'', ''ordered product'', ''cancelled order''), sum numeric_value for matching events; treat null numeric_value as 0; type matching is case-insensitive exact match. - Event counts: for each target type (''active on site'', ''viewed product'', ''ordered product'', ''placed order'', ''received email'', ''opened email'', ''clicked email''), count matching events; type matching is case-insensitive exact match. - email_open_rate = count_opened_email divided by count_received_email when count_received_email > 0; otherwise null; no rounding. - Join: left join the aggregated metrics to the person rows on person_id and source_relation; retain all person columns and add metric fields. - Null policy: - If a person_id/source_relation has no matching events, all metric fields (dates, sums, counts, rate) are null from the left join. - If events exist but none match a specific metric’s type, that metric’s sum or count is 0. - Determinism: - Each event contributes to at most one of the listed revenue sums and to at most one of the listed count metrics based on its type. - Events with null type do not match any target type; duplicates in events are included as-is. - Revenue sums include only numeric_value from matching events; null numeric_value contributes 0.'
      columns:
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person identifier from the person table.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ADDRESS_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Address line 1 from the person table.
      - name: ADDRESS_2
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Address line 2 from the person table.
      - name: CITY
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: City from the person table.
      - name: COUNTRY
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country from the person table.
      - name: ZIP
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Postal code from the person table.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp the person record was created in the source.
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email address from the person table.
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name from the person table.
      - name: LATITUDE
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Latitude from the person table.
      - name: LONGITUDE
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Longitude from the person table.
      - name: ORGANIZATION
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization from the person table.
      - name: phone_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Phone number from the person table.
      - name: REGION
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from the person table.
      - name: timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Timezone from the person table.
      - name: TITLE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Title from the person table.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp the person record was last updated in the source.
      - name: LAST_EVENT_DATE
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent event timestamp stored on the person record in the source.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream source system identifier from the person table.
      - name: first_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest occurred_on date across that person and source_relation; null when no events.
      - name: last_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest occurred_on date across that person and source_relation; null when no events.
      - name: sum_revenue_refunded_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for events of type 'refunded order'; null numeric_value treated as 0; type match is case-insensitive.
      - name: sum_revenue_placed_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for events of type 'placed order'; null numeric_value treated as 0; type match is case-insensitive.
      - name: sum_revenue_ordered_product
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for events of type 'ordered product'; null numeric_value treated as 0; type match is case-insensitive.
      - name: sum_revenue_cancelled_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of numeric_value for events of type 'cancelled order'; null numeric_value treated as 0; type match is case-insensitive.
      - name: count_active_on_site
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'active on site' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_viewed_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'viewed product' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'ordered product' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_placed_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'placed order' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_received_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'received email' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'opened email' (case-insensitive).
      - name: count_clicked_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'clicked email' (case-insensitive).
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opened-to-received email ratio when received > 0; otherwise null; no rounding.

references.name: staging.stg_klaviyo__person
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from all rows in staging.stg_klaviyo__person; this defines the output grain (one row per person_id and source_relation). - From staging.stg_klaviyo__event, project person_id, source_relation, occurred_on as the calendar date of occurred_at (day-level truncation, no timezone conversion), type, and numeric_value. - Aggregate events by (person_id, source_relation): - first_event_on = minimum occurred_on; last_event_on = maximum occurred_on. - Revenue sums: for each target type (''refunded order'', ''placed order'', ''ordered product'', ''cancelled order''), sum numeric_value for matching events; treat null numeric_value as 0; type matching is case-insensitive exact match. - Event counts: for each target type (''active on site'', ''viewed product'', ''ordered product'', ''placed order'', ''received email'', ''opened email'', ''clicked email''), count matching events; type matching is case-insensitive exact match. - email_open_rate = count_opened_email divided by count_received_email when count_received_email > 0; otherwise null; no rounding. - Join: left join the aggregated metrics to the person rows on person_id and source_relation; retain all person columns and add metric fields. - Null policy: - If a person_id/source_relation has no matching events, all metric fields (dates, sums, counts, rate) are null from the left join. - If events exist but none match a specific metric’s type, that metric’s sum or count is 0. - Determinism: - Each event contributes to at most one of the listed revenue sums and to at most one of the listed count metrics based on its type. - Events with null type do not match any target type; duplicates in events are included as-is. - Revenue sums include only numeric_value from matching events; null numeric_value contributes 0.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: klaviyo__campaigns
      description: Campaign analysis with enriched attributes joined to campaign-attributed event aggregates and derived rates
      grain: One row per campaign_id per variation_id per source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__campaigns_enriched
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__events
      business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_klaviyo__campaigns_enriched (c) as the base, one row per campaign_id, variation_id, source_relation. - From intermediate.int_klaviyo__events (e), keep only events with a non-null last_touch_campaign_id (campaign-attributed). - For each (campaign_id = last_touch_campaign_id, variation_id, source_relation), compute: - active_days: number of distinct occurred_on values (no date truncation). - total_placed_orders: count of events where type equals "placed order" (case-insensitive). - total_amount_positive: sum of amount_positive, treating nulls as 0 within the sum. - total_amount_negative: sum of amount_negative, treating nulls as 0 within the sum. - product_view_to_order_rate_campaign: if there is at least one event where type equals "viewed product" (case-insensitive), divide the number of "ordered product" events by the number of "viewed product" events; otherwise set to null; no rounding. - gmv_net_campaign: total_amount_positive minus total_amount_negative. - Left join these aggregates to c on campaign_id, variation_id, and source_relation; select all c columns plus the aggregate fields. - When no events match a given c row, all aggregate fields are null. Event counts are row-level (no de-duplication) except active_days, which is distinct on occurred_on. Event type comparisons are case-insensitive.'

      - name: SENT_AT

      - name: STATUS

      - name: STATUS_ID

        description: Numeric status identifier from the enriched campaigns model
      - name: SUBJECT

        description: Total received email events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total opened email events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_clicked_email

        description: Total clicked email events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_placed_order

        description: Total placed order events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total ordered product events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: count_refunded_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total refunded order events from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: gmv_gross
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross GMV from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: gmv_net
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net GMV from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opened-to-received email rate from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: email_click_to_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicked-to-opened email rate from the enriched campaigns model; pass-through
      - name: campaign_variation_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stable key for campaign_id+variation_id+source_relation provided by the enriched campaigns model
      - name: active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct occurred_on values among campaign-attributed events; NULL when no events joined
      - name: total_placed_orders
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of events with type 'placed order' (case-insensitive); counts all matching rows; NULL when no events joined
      - name: total_amount_positive
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of amount_positive with nulls treated as 0 within the sum; NULL when no events joined
      - name: total_amount_negative
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of amount_negative with nulls treated as 0 within the sum; NULL when no events joined

        description: Number of 'ordered product' events divided by 'viewed product' events (case-insensitive); NULL when there are zero 'viewed product' events; no rounding
      - name: gmv_net_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Net GMV from aggregates: total_amount_positive minus total_amount_negative (null amounts treated as 0 within sums); NULL when no events joined'

references.name: intermediate.int_klaviyo__campaigns_enriched
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_klaviyo__campaigns_enriched (c) as the base, one row per campaign_id, variation_id, source_relation. - From intermediate.int_klaviyo__events (e), keep only events with a non-null last_touch_campaign_id (campaign-attributed). - For each (campaign_id = last_touch_campaign_id, variation_id, source_relation), compute: - active_days: number of distinct occurred_on values (no date truncation). - total_placed_orders: count of events where type equals "placed order" (case-insensitive). - total_amount_positive: sum of amount_positive, treating nulls as 0 within the sum. - total_amount_negative: sum of amount_negative, treating nulls as 0 within the sum. - product_view_to_order_rate_campaign: if there is at least one event where type equals "viewed product" (case-insensitive), divide the number of "ordered product" events by the number of "viewed product" events; otherwise set to null; no rounding. - gmv_net_campaign: total_amount_positive minus total_amount_negative. - Left join these aggregates to c on campaign_id, variation_id, and source_relation; select all c columns plus the aggregate fields. - When no events match a given c row, all aggregate fields are null. Event counts are row-level (no de-duplication) except active_days, which is distinct on occurred_on. Event type comparisons are case-insensitive.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: klaviyo__events
      description: Analysis-ready Klaviyo events with per-event sequencing, net revenue, and per-person daily rollups
      grain: One row per source event from intermediate.int_klaviyo__events; duplicates preserved
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__events
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in intermediate.int_klaviyo__events with no filtering or de-duplication; all base columns pass through unchanged. - Per-event enrichments: - event_net_revenue: treat nulls as zero, then amount_positive minus amount_negative. - person_event_seq: 1, 2, ... per person ordered by occurred_at ascending; ties on identical timestamps have unspecified order. - prev_occurred_on: the previous occurred_on date per person when ordering by occurred_on ascending; date_gap_days: whole-day difference between prev_occurred_on and occurred_on. For the first-by-date event per person, both are NULL. Ordering uses date only; multiple events on the same date are not further ordered. - is_attributed: 1 when either session_touch_type or touch_type is present, else 0. - Per-person daily aggregates (per_day): - Group by person_id, source_relation, and occurred_on. - day_opened_email: count events whose type equals "Opened Email" (case-insensitive). - day_clicked_email: count events whose type equals "Clicked Email" (case-insensitive). - day_placed_order: count events whose type equals "Placed Order" (case-insensitive). - day_ordered_product: count events whose type equals "Ordered Product" (case-insensitive). - day_amount_positive: sum amount_positive treating nulls as zero; day_amount_negative: sum amount_negative treating nulls as zero. - Join per-event rows to per-day aggregates by person_id, source_relation, and occurred_on using a left join; if any join key is NULL or unmatched, daily fields are NULL. - day_net_revenue: day_amount_positive minus day_amount_negative. - day_click_to_open_rate: day_clicked_email divided by day_opened_email when day_opened_email > 0; otherwise NULL; no rounding. - Daily aggregates are per (person_id, source_relation, occurred_on) and repeat for all events sharing that key; no additional de-duplication is performed.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Originating source/system identifier; part of the daily aggregate join key
      - name: event_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event identifier from the source; combined with source_relation typically defines a source event record
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person identifier used for per-person sequencing and daily grouping
      - name: metric_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric identifier from Klaviyo as provided by the source
      - name: type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event type; daily counts compare case-insensitively to the phrases Opened Email, Clicked Email, Placed Order, and Ordered Product
      - name: UUID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event UUID when available from the source
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Variation identifier when present from the source
      - name: numeric_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Numeric value parsed upstream from event properties; passed through unchanged
      - name: event_attribution
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Attribution payload as provided by the source
      - name: occurred_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Event timestamp used to order person_event_seq ascending
      - name: occurred_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Event calendar date used for daily grouping and date-based lag/gap calculations
      - name: touch_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct touch identifier from the source event
      - name: touch_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct touch type from the source (e.g., campaign or flow)
      - name: last_touch_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved touch identifier from the source (direct or inherited)
      - name: session_touch_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Session-resolved touch type; used with touch_type to set is_attributed
      - name: prev_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Upstream previous event timestamp for the person when provided
      - name: last_touch_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved campaign id for campaign-attributed events from the source
      - name: last_touch_flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved flow id for flow-attributed events from the source
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from upstream campaign metadata
      - name: CAMPAIGN_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign type label from upstream campaign metadata
      - name: campaign_subject_line
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign subject line from upstream campaign metadata
      - name: flow_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow name from upstream flow metadata
      - name: person_city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person city from the source profile data
      - name: person_country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person country from the source profile data
      - name: person_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person region from the source profile data
      - name: person_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person email address from the source profile data
      - name: person_timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person timezone from the source profile data
      - name: integration_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric integration identifier from the source metric metadata
      - name: integration_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric integration name from the source metric metadata
      - name: integration_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Metric integration category from the source metric metadata
      - name: inter_event_minutes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Minutes between the previous and current event for the person as provided by the source
      - name: session_seq
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Monotonic session sequence per person as provided by the source
      - name: is_engagement_event
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Upstream flag for engagement-type events; passed through unchanged
      - name: amount_positive
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Positive revenue amount from the source; downstream treats NULL as 0
      - name: amount_negative
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Refund/cancellation amount from the source; downstream treats NULL as 0
      - name: event_net_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Per-event net revenue: amount_positive (NULL as 0) minus amount_negative (NULL as 0)'
      - name: person_event_seq
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Row number per person ordered by occurred_at ascending; ties on identical timestamps have unspecified order
      - name: prev_occurred_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Previous event date for the person when ordering by occurred_on ascending; NULL for the first-by-date event
      - name: date_gap_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Difference in days between prev_occurred_on and occurred_on; NULL when prev_occurred_on is NULL
      - name: is_attributed
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 when either session_touch_type or touch_type is present, else 0
      - name: day_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Per-person daily count of events whose type equals 'Opened Email' (case-insensitive) for the same source_relation and occurred_on
      - name: day_clicked_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Per-person daily count of events whose type equals 'Clicked Email' (case-insensitive) for the same source_relation and occurred_on
      - name: day_placed_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Per-person daily count of events whose type equals 'Placed Order' (case-insensitive) for the same source_relation and occurred_on
      - name: day_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Per-person daily count of events whose type equals 'Ordered Product' (case-insensitive) for the same source_relation and occurred_on
      - name: day_amount_positive
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Per-person daily sum of amount_positive, treating NULL as 0, for the same source_relation and occurred_on
      - name: day_amount_negative
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Per-person daily sum of amount_negative, treating NULL as 0, for the same source_relation and occurred_on
      - name: day_net_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Per-person daily net revenue: day_amount_positive minus day_amount_negative for the same source_relation and occurred_on'
      - name: day_click_to_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Per-person daily ratio day_clicked_email divided by day_opened_email; NULL when day_opened_email is 0; no rounding

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from all rows in intermediate.int_klaviyo__events with no filtering or de-duplication; all base columns pass through unchanged. - Per-event enrichments: - event_net_revenue: treat nulls as zero, then amount_positive minus amount_negative. - person_event_seq: 1, 2, ... per person ordered by occurred_at ascending; ties on identical timestamps have unspecified order. - prev_occurred_on: the previous occurred_on date per person when ordering by occurred_on ascending; date_gap_days: whole-day difference between prev_occurred_on and occurred_on. For the first-by-date event per person, both are NULL. Ordering uses date only; multiple events on the same date are not further ordered. - is_attributed: 1 when either session_touch_type or touch_type is present, else 0. - Per-person daily aggregates (per_day): - Group by person_id, source_relation, and occurred_on. - day_opened_email: count events whose type equals "Opened Email" (case-insensitive). - day_clicked_email: count events whose type equals "Clicked Email" (case-insensitive). - day_placed_order: count events whose type equals "Placed Order" (case-insensitive). - day_ordered_product: count events whose type equals "Ordered Product" (case-insensitive). - day_amount_positive: sum amount_positive treating nulls as zero; day_amount_negative: sum amount_negative treating nulls as zero. - Join per-event rows to per-day aggregates by person_id, source_relation, and occurred_on using a left join; if any join key is NULL or unmatched, daily fields are NULL. - day_net_revenue: day_amount_positive minus day_amount_negative. - day_click_to_open_rate: day_clicked_email divided by day_opened_email when day_opened_email > 0; otherwise NULL; no rounding. - Daily aggregates are per (person_id, source_relation, occurred_on) and repeat for all events sharing that key; no additional de-duplication is performed.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: klaviyo__flows
      description: Flow-level dataset joining enriched flow attributes with flow-attributed event aggregates to expose activity, revenue, and rates per flow_id+variation_id+source_relation
      grain: One row per flow_id per variation_id per source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__flows_enriched
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__events
      business_logic: '- Base rows: take all records from intermediate.int_klaviyo__flows_enriched; each row is keyed by (flow_id, variation_id, source_relation) and is preserved even if there are no matching events. - Event filter: use only events that have a non-null last_touch_flow_id (i.e., events attributed to a flow). - Grouping: aggregate events by (last_touch_flow_id as flow_id, variation_id, source_relation); no other deduplication is applied. - Aggregations per group: - active_days: count distinct occurred_on values exactly as stored (no date truncation); null occurred_on values do not contribute. - total_placed_orders: count of events whose type equals "placed order" using a case-insensitive comparison; other events do not contribute. - total_amount_positive: sum of amount_positive with null treated as 0 across all events in the group. - total_amount_negative: sum of amount_negative with null treated as 0 across all events in the group. - product_view_to_order_rate_flow: if there is at least one event of type "viewed product" (case-insensitive), divide the count of "ordered product" events by the count of "viewed product" events; otherwise set to null; no rounding. - gmv_net_flow: total_amount_positive minus total_amount_negative. - Join: left join the aggregates to the base on exact equality of (flow_id, variation_id, source_relation). - Null policy: - If no events match a base row, all aggregate fields are null. - If a group exists but a specific metric has no qualifying events, that metric is 0 for counts and sums; the rate is null when its denominator is 0. - Types/units: division produces a double; sums are in the same currency units as the source; no rounding or formatting is applied.'

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow created timestamp (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)

        description: Flow status (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)
      - name: updated_at

        description: Last updated timestamp (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)

        description: Archive flag (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)
      - name: trigger_type

        description: Trigger type (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)
      - name: source_relation

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow variation identifier; join key to aggregates

      - name: count_clicked_email

        description: Precomputed count of clicked emails (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)

        description: Precomputed count of placed order events (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched; distinct from total_placed_orders)
      - name: count_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Precomputed count of ordered product events (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)
      - name: count_refunded_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Precomputed count of refunded orders (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)
      - name: gmv_gross
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross GMV (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)
      - name: gmv_net
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net GMV (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opened/received email rate (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)
      - name: email_click_to_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Click-to-open rate (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)
      - name: flow_variation_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stable key for flow+variation (passthrough from int_klaviyo__flows_enriched)
      - name: active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of occurred_on values for attributed events; null when no matching events
      - name: total_placed_orders
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of attributed events with type 'placed order' (case-insensitive); null when no matching events
      - name: total_amount_positive
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of amount_positive with null treated as 0 for attributed events; null when no matching events
      - name: total_amount_negative
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of amount_negative with null treated as 0 for attributed events; null when no matching events
      - name: product_view_to_order_rate_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ordered-product events divided by viewed-product events (case-insensitive); null when no viewed-product events
      - name: gmv_net_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_amount_positive minus total_amount_negative; null when no matching events

- name: klaviyo__person_campaign_flow
      description: Person by campaign/flow touch dataset with span days, conversion rates, net revenue, and a conversion flag.
      grain: One row per person_id, last_touch_campaign_id, last_touch_flow_id, variation_id, source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_campaign_flow
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_campaign_flow and retain all columns without filtering or re-aggregation. - Compute touch_span_days: if first_event_at and last_event_at are present, truncate both to calendar day, take the day difference, and add 1 so same-day spans equal 1; otherwise set NULL. - Compute rates only when denominators are greater than zero; otherwise set NULL: - product_view_to_order_rate_touch: ordered product count divided by viewed product count. - email_open_rate_touch: opened email count divided by received email count. - email_click_to_open_rate_touch: clicked email count divided by opened email count. Use floating-point division, no rounding or capping; if the numerator is NULL the result is NULL. - Compute net_revenue_touch as placed order revenue plus ordered-product revenue minus refunded and cancelled order revenue; treat NULL inputs as zero. - Compute has_converted as 1 when count_placed_order > 0, else 0; NULL counts are treated as not greater than zero.'
      columns:
      - name: person_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Person identifier for the touch grouping.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: last_touch_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier for the last attributed touch; may be NULL.
      - name: last_touch_flow_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Flow identifier for the last attributed touch; may be NULL.
      - name: variation_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Variation identifier for the attributed touch when available.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Origin data source relation name.
      - name: first_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: First event timestamp in the touch window from the source.
      - name: last_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last event timestamp in the touch window from the source.
      - name: sum_revenue_refunded_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total refunded order revenue from the source; may be NULL.
      - name: sum_revenue_placed_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total placed order revenue from the source; may be NULL.
      - name: sum_revenue_ordered_product
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total ordered product revenue from the source; may be NULL.
      - name: sum_revenue_checkout_started
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total checkout-started revenue from the source.
      - name: sum_revenue_cancelled_order
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total cancelled order revenue from the source; may be NULL.
      - name: count_active_on_site
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active-on-site events from the source.
      - name: count_viewed_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of viewed product events; denominator for the view-to-order rate.
      - name: count_ordered_product
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of ordered product events; numerator for the view-to-order rate.
      - name: count_placed_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of placed order events used to set the conversion flag.
      - name: count_refunded_order
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of refunded order events from the source.
      - name: count_received_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of received email events; denominator for the email open rate.
      - name: count_clicked_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of clicked email events; numerator for the click-to-open rate.
      - name: count_opened_email
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of opened email events; numerator for open rate and denominator for click-to-open.
      - name: count_marked_email_as_spam
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of emails marked as spam; passthrough.
      - name: count_unsubscribed
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of email unsubscribe events; passthrough.
      - name: count_received_sms
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of received SMS events; passthrough.
      - name: count_clicked_sms
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of clicked SMS events; passthrough.
      - name: count_sent_sms
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of sent SMS events; passthrough.
      - name: count_unsubscribed_from_sms
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of SMS unsubscribe events; passthrough.
      - name: touch_span_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Inclusive number of calendar days between first_event_at and last_event_at after truncating to day; NULL if either is NULL.
      - name: product_view_to_order_rate_touch
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of viewed-product events that led to an ordered product when views > 0; floating-point; no rounding.
      - name: email_open_rate_touch
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of received emails that were opened when received > 0; floating-point; no rounding.
      - name: email_click_to_open_rate_touch
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of opened emails that were clicked when opens > 0; floating-point; no rounding.
      - name: net_revenue_touch
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Placed plus ordered-product revenue minus refunded and cancelled revenue; NULL inputs treated as zero.
      - name: has_converted
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 when count_placed_order > 0 else 0; NULL counts behave as not greater than zero.
