references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_campaign_flow and retain all columns without filtering or re-aggregation. - Compute touch_span_days: if first_event_at and last_event_at are present, truncate both to calendar day, take the day difference, and add 1 so same-day spans equal 1; otherwise set NULL. - Compute rates only when denominators are greater than zero; otherwise set NULL: - product_view_to_order_rate_touch: ordered product count divided by viewed product count. - email_open_rate_touch: opened email count divided by received email count. - email_click_to_open_rate_touch: clicked email count divided by opened email count. Use floating-point division, no rounding or capping; if the numerator is NULL the result is NULL. - Compute net_revenue_touch as placed order revenue plus ordered-product revenue minus refunded and cancelled order revenue; treat NULL inputs as zero. - Compute has_converted as 1 when count_placed_order > 0, else 0; NULL counts are treated as not greater than zero.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: klaviyo__persons
      description: Enriched person profile joined with activity spans, retention flags/rates, and paid retention by month
      grain: One row per (person_id, source_relation) present in intermediate.int_klaviyo__persons_enriched
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__persons_enriched
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_metrics
      - intermediate.int_klaviyo__events
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_klaviyo__persons_enriched (p) and retain all columns unchanged. - Left join intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_metrics (pm) on (person_id, source_relation) to add first_event_on, last_event_on, active_days, active_weeks, active_months, and missing_day_count; these fields are NULL when no pm row exists. - Derive paid_months from intermediate.int_klaviyo__events by filtering to events whose type text equals "placed order" ignoring case; for each (person_id, source_relation), count the number of distinct calendar months with at least one such event as paid_retained_month_count. - Left join paid_months on (person_id, source_relation); when missing, set paid_retained_month_count to 0. - Compute inclusive activity spans from pm dates: - days_span: number of calendar days from first_event_on through last_event_on, inclusive; NULL if either date is NULL. - weeks_span: number of calendar weeks spanned between the two dates, counted inclusively; NULL if either date is NULL. - months_span: number of calendar months spanned between the two dates, counted inclusively; NULL if either date is NULL. - Retention rates (floating-point division, no rounding): - active_retention_rate_day: active_days divided by days_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - active_retention_rate_week: active_weeks divided by weeks_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - active_retention_rate_month: active_months divided by months_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - Retention flags: - has_7day_retention: 1 when the elapsed days between first_event_on and last_event_on is at least 7 and active_days is at least 2; otherwise 0 (NULLs yield 0). - has_30day_retention: 1 when the elapsed days between first_event_on and last_event_on is at least 30 and active_days is at least 2; otherwise 0 (NULLs yield 0). - Paid retention rate: - paid_retention_rate_month: paid_retained_month_count divided by months_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL (uses the 0 default when the paid month count is missing). - All rows from p are preserved; no additional filtering or deduplication beyond the left joins.'

      - name: missing_day_count

      - name: days_span
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of calendar days from first_event_on to last_event_on inclusive; NULL if either date is NULL
      - name: weeks_span
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of calendar weeks spanned between the dates, counted inclusively; NULL if either date is NULL
      - name: months_span
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of calendar months spanned between the dates, counted inclusively; NULL if either date is NULL
      - name: active_retention_rate_day
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Active days divided by days_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL; not rounded
      - name: active_retention_rate_week
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Active weeks divided by weeks_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL; not rounded
      - name: active_retention_rate_month
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Active months divided by months_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL; not rounded
      - name: has_7day_retention
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 when the elapsed days between first and last activity is at least 7 and active_days is at least 2; otherwise 0
      - name: has_30day_retention
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 when the elapsed days between first and last activity is at least 30 and active_days is at least 2; otherwise 0
      - name: paid_retained_month_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct calendar months with a 'placed order' event for the person/source (type match is case-insensitive); set to 0 when none
      - name: paid_retention_rate_month
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Paid retained month count divided by months_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL; not rounded

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_klaviyo__persons_enriched (p) and retain all columns unchanged. - Left join intermediate.int_klaviyo__person_metrics (pm) on (person_id, source_relation) to add first_event_on, last_event_on, active_days, active_weeks, active_months, and missing_day_count; these fields are NULL when no pm row exists. - Derive paid_months from intermediate.int_klaviyo__events by filtering to events whose type text equals "placed order" ignoring case; for each (person_id, source_relation), count the number of distinct calendar months with at least one such event as paid_retained_month_count. - Left join paid_months on (person_id, source_relation); when missing, set paid_retained_month_count to 0. - Compute inclusive activity spans from pm dates: - days_span: number of calendar days from first_event_on through last_event_on, inclusive; NULL if either date is NULL. - weeks_span: number of calendar weeks spanned between the two dates, counted inclusively; NULL if either date is NULL. - months_span: number of calendar months spanned between the two dates, counted inclusively; NULL if either date is NULL. - Retention rates (floating-point division, no rounding): - active_retention_rate_day: active_days divided by days_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - active_retention_rate_week: active_weeks divided by weeks_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - active_retention_rate_month: active_months divided by months_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL. - Retention flags: - has_7day_retention: 1 when the elapsed days between first_event_on and last_event_on is at least 7 and active_days is at least 2; otherwise 0 (NULLs yield 0). - has_30day_retention: 1 when the elapsed days between first_event_on and last_event_on is at least 30 and active_days is at least 2; otherwise 0 (NULLs yield 0). - Paid retention rate: - paid_retention_rate_month: paid_retained_month_count divided by months_span when the span is positive; otherwise NULL (uses the 0 default when the paid month count is missing). - All rows from p are preserved; no additional filtering or deduplication beyond the left joins.'
